rounds.text: Orosil Smiths India Ltd trades at an extraordinary valuation discount, boasting a Price-to-Earnings ratio of just 1.19x against a sector benchmark of 67.46x, alongside an EV/EBITDA of 0.85x [E1, E6]. This low multiple is paired with exceptional capital efficiency, delivering a Return on Equity of 90.52% and a Return on Capital Employed of 105.35%, both towering over their respective sector benchmarks of 10.04% and 11.43% [E4, E5]. Furthermore, insiders are backing this fundamental strength with conviction, as promoters have increased their holding by 10.33 percentage points from 50.50% in September 2023 to 60.83% by June 2026 [E7]. The market momentum fully supports this undervaluation thesis, evidenced by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500, a twelve-month price return of 44.3%, and a textbook bullish technical setup where the price sits above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages in a golden cross formation [E11, E12, E13, E23]. This impressive setup operates against a supportive macro backdrop, with the Consumer Durables sector benefiting from a tailwind score of +0.75 [E24, E26]. Conceded: the business carries significant historical volatility of 63.1% and a severe peak-to-trough drawdown of -91.1% [E14, E15].
